Work.

  1. Fraud detector
  2. Expense tracker
  3. Digital diary

Fraud detector

A Flask 3.1 web app with Google OAuth 2.0 sign-in and OpenAPI docs, a DistilBERT text model, an Isolation Forest with a scikit-learn ensemble, and a Docker image for a Hugging Face Space.

Expense tracker

A Netlify-hosted web client with receipt scanning in the browser, an Expo and React Native mobile app, a Spring Boot 4.1.1 REST API on Java 26, and PostgreSQL.

Digital diary

Server-rendered pages with Jinja2, FastAPI JSON endpoints with JWT in HttpOnly cookies and passkeys, SQLAlchemy over SQLite or Postgres, and per-entry sharing with expiring links.
